CA.name: Nodding onion
CA.citation: NC Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox; native range confirmed Canada to Mexico. Species-specific, distinguished from ramps/wild leek (Allium tricoccum)

US.name: Nodding onion
US.citation: Lady Bird Johnson Wildflower Center; Flora of the Southeastern United States (FSUS). Also documented as Lady's leek. Mildly toxic if eaten in quantity (sulfides)
